title: Survey-aware Machine Learning: A Guideline for Valid Population Health Inference based on Scoping Review
abstract: arXiv:2605.08963v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine Learning (ML) models trained on complex health surveys such as the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) often ignore primary sampling units, stratification variables, and sampling weights. This practice violates the independence assumptions of standard evaluation methods. As a result, estimates become biased, uncertainty is underestimated, and fairness assessments fail to reflect population-level disparities. We propose Survey-aware Machine Learning (SaML), a nine-step guideline that incorporates survey design metadata across the ML lifecycle. Through a scoping review of 16 methodological papers, we summarize existing work on weighted model training, design-based cross-validation, and survey-adjusted performance evaluation. We also identify gaps in hyperparameter tuning and deployment. We provide task-specific guidance that clarifies which steps are required for different analytical objectives. SaML

translated_title: 感知调查设计的机器学习（SaML）：基于范围综述的人群健康有效推断指南
translated_abstract: 基于复杂健康调查（如国家健康与营养调查NHANES）训练的机器学习（ML）模型往往忽略初级抽样单元、分层变量和抽样权重。这种做法违反了标准评估方法的独立性假设，导致估计量产生偏差、不确定性被低估，且公平性评估无法反映人群层面的差异。我们提出了感知调查设计的机器学习，这是一个九步骤指南，将调查设计元数据纳入机器学习的整个生命周期。通过对16篇方法学论文的范围综述，我们总结了加权模型训练、基于设计的交叉验证以及调查调整性能评估方面的现有研究工作，并识别了超参数调优和模型部署方面的研究空白。我们还提供了针对特定任务的指导，阐明了不同分析目标所需的步骤。
tldr: 本文提出了一个九步骤的感知调查设计机器学习（SaML）指南，通过将调查设计元数据（如抽样权重、分层变量等）纳入机器学习全生命周期，解决基于复杂健康调查数据训练模型时估计偏差、不确定性低估和公平性评估失真的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Survey-aware Machine Learning (SaML), a nine-step guideline that incorporates survey design metadata throughout the ML lifecycle to address biased estimates, underestimated uncertainty, and flawed fairness assessments when training models on complex health survey data.
